To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) 50% of the research articles published in JPMA and 40% in PJMR are based on statistical methods; (b) 60% of the articles published in JP MA and 50% in PJMR do not use any statistical methods, (c) of the 40% of articles published in JP M A and 50% of PJMR that do use statistical methods, 50% are based on descriptive statistics and 50% on inferential statistics;
the research articles published during the year 1986 in JPMA and PJMR are not statistically analyzed properly.
